Description: I11 SECURITY DEFINER bypass remains an unrecorded exception (EL-3 => standing violation). I11 is rated Ready, so the engine phase could be asked to verify I11 while it stands Violated; GD-2 forbids binding a gate on a violated/suspended rule. No dated ADR-board commitment exists yet (PQ-2).
Mitigation: Record the I11 exception in R9 via the ADR board (dated commitment), resolve the P3-I11 conflict, and keep I11 a hard gate prerequisite. No gate may bind the I11 verification until C6 closes.

Description: The EC8 audit chain is ambiguous at the constitutional-source level (object-model 2.3 projection omits Verification/Gate; section 4 defines the full chain). Phase 3 recorded its 2.3 choice and surfaced PQ-1; the engine must not build the EC8 audit until the ADR board selects the chain.
Mitigation: ADR board selects the EC8 audit chain (PQ-1); update MODEL-TRACEABILITY accordingly before the engine audit is built.

Description: The source-of-truth fixture is hand-maintained from object-model 2.1-2.3; there is no mechanical markdown extraction. Range equality is pinned by containment, not exact validFrom/validTo equality. A future constitutional edit without a fixture update would pass silently.
Mitigation: Re-run fixture reconciliation on any constitutional-object-model.md change; consider mechanical extraction or exact range-equality assertions before the engine phase; add a change-checklist entry.

Description: Models carry declarative rule strings (OWN/VD/GD/DP/EL). A future engineer could mistake rule text for executable enforcement and wire it before the architectural review approves runtime behavior, violating RELATIONSHIPS_RUNTIME_PROHIBITED.
Mitigation: Keep runtime-prohibition markers on every model; re-verify zero runtime wiring before the engine phase; require a dedicated architectural review before any execution (DEC-2 gate).

Description: Range-compatibility is overlap-based (non-empty intersection), not containment-based. A composed-of kind whose full range extends outside a model's objectKinds would pass today; the engine will need link-level type checks to reject ill-typed links by construction (DEC-3.3 intent).
Mitigation: Carry the containment/link-level typing requirement into the engine phase; validate instantiated links against vocabulary ranges before traversal.

Description: Identity rules cover 13 of 19 object kinds; Principle/Invariant/Lifecycle/Ownership/Traceability/Baseline have no identity anchors (documented as registry-anchored-only scoping). Deferred kinds are not yet identity-stable for the engine.
Mitigation: Revisit the deferred kinds before the engine relies on their identity; the ADR amendment instrument is now identity-anchored (minimum required by the decision).

Description: Some models' objectKinds include kinds not used in composed-of (e.g., MODEL-AUTHORITY-RESOLUTION lists Exception/Baseline). Over-approximation is documented and harmless today, but could mask an intended composition.
Mitigation: Keep composed-of and objectKinds reconciled in the model statuses; no change required now.

Description: Object-model section 1 objects Governance Rule / Exit Criterion / Relationship are subsumed under Rule (superclass) and the link concept; not called out in one place. Risk of a reader expecting distinct kinds.
Mitigation: Document the subsumption explicitly in the object-relationship report or model catalog.
